title: "Now You See It, Now You Don't!" Captain Henry S. Shields, HQ USAFE/INOMP, September 19, 1976
doc_notes: This is an archival record from the USAF regarding the 1976 Tehran UFO incident, which contains detailed reports of multiple encounters including a landing.

encounters.summary: Two F-4 Phantom crews of the Imperial Iranian Air Force reported multiple UFOs, including a craft that detached a smaller object, caused weapons and communication failures, and landed on a dry lake bed.
encounters.quote: it landed gently and cast a bright light over a two-three kilometer area
